name: Maddie Phillips
bio: Madelaine Rachel Phillips (born September 6, 1994) is a Canadian actress who portrayed Randeen in Ghost Wars, Devon D'Marco in Project Mc2, and Sterling Wesley in the 2020 Netflix teen comedy-drama television series Teenage Bounty Hunters.
